pages.title: End Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Appears above the center of the End after defeating the Ender Dragon, floating in place.$(br2)§lCondition: §r Works while in a Curios slot, or in the main hand / off hand.$(br2)Wings of the End: grants free flight.$(br)End Embers: every 10 current experience points grants +1% damage, with no cap.$(br)Blast Immunity: immune to explosion damage.$(br)Stardust Echo: projectile damage reduced by 75%.$(br)Body of Bedrock: physical damage reduced by 50%.$(br)Arcane Barrier: magic damage reduced by 80%.$(br)Void Anchor: immune to void damage; falling into the void sends you back to your respawn point.$(br)Unburdened Soul: immune to Mining Fatigue and to underwater or airborne mining penalties.$(br)Freedom Step: immune to Slowness and movement slowdowns.$(br)End Kin: Endermen, Endermites, Shulkers and the Ender Dragon no longer treat you as an enemy.
